FN-HGVHY33-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 424
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Corley Ellis
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/16/2026
House Bill 424 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Insurance,
paid from the Insurance Department Fund, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost
of any personnel hired to staff the Office of Risk and Resilience, established by this bill,
including the compensation of one exempt service employee to be set by the Commission of
Insurance.
